answer: Split rewards by niche, not by head. Each epoch the network publishes task niches, such as lagoon water-quality forecasts or quartz supply pricing, and each niche has a fixed pool shared among every answer that passes peer review. One operator's clones tend to crowd the same niche with near-identical work, so a hundred copies just carve up one pool while each pays its own entry fee. Reaching the summit of earnings takes genuinely different skills, which copying cannot fake.
